The Letter
Happy Birthday, Baba.

HAPPY BIRTHDAY, BABA JAANII ❤❤

Dear Baba Jani,

Happy Birthday To My Dill Ka Totaa ❤❤

I feel very lucky to have you in my life. Thank you for always being there, for making me smile, and for all the little things you do that make our family happier.

On your special day, I pray that Allah always keeps you happy, healthy, and blessed. May He give you many more beautiful years filled with peace, joy, and countless wonderful memories.

I hope this little website makes your birthday a little more special. I made it just for you, with lots of love. ❤️

Happy Birthday once again, Baba Jani! 🎉🎂❤️

With lots and lots of love, The ONE & ONLY Aun Khan ❤️
28 . 08

Made with love, for the best Baba in the world.
